# Customer Application Portal

This fictional system has not been implemented. No real personal data is
included in this fixture.

- Customers sign in, submit applications, and see only their own applications
  and documents.
- Case workers review and approve the applications assigned to them.
- Customers may replace supporting documents until approval.
- The portal stores applications in a database and documents in a file store.
- An external email service sends status notifications to applicants.
- The product team owns the business rules.

Document categories, the consequences of approval, and operational details
remain unspecified. No implementation or verification evidence is supplied.
